name: Private lessons
tagline: One-on-one with a USPTA pro, on clay.
audience: All ages and ability levels, from a first swing to match strategy.
description: Every lesson is built around you: your goals, your game, your schedule. Fred has taught for more than 35 years and works with beginners, returning players, juniors and competitive adults.
Lessons run on the club's clay courts, which are easier on knees and reward patient, well-built points.

name: Court time
tagline: Six lit clay courts, open 7 to 7.
audience: Anyone who wants to play. Bring a partner or ask Fred to find you one.

Play often? The ACE PASS covers five visits for one flat price.

audience: Ages 5 to 17, grouped by age and level.

Racquets are available to borrow, so there is nothing to buy before the first session.
